title: 游戏稳定性与碰撞问题
description: 游戏几乎无法正常运作，寻路系统损坏导致崩溃，行星碰撞行为异常，透明墙阻挡。
evidence: натыкаться на прозрачные стены недоделанного геймплея
I slowly descended into the planet, and got teleported out, when I increased my speed, my ship crashed horribly, and I died. But it didn't show the ground.

evidence_items.quote: I slowly descended into the planet, and got teleported out, when I increased my speed, my ship crashed horribly, and I died. But it didn't show the ground.
evidence_items.description: 撞向行星时飞船缓慢下降后被传送出去，加速后飞船坠毁但未显示地面
